create_WeightsMapper: create a WeightsMapper to rename model weight keys using regex, prefix, suffix, and substring patterns
build_AutoWeightsLoader: build an AutoWeightsLoader to automatically load torch tensor weights into a PyTorch nn.Module with skip and ignore rules
make_layers: make a list of pipeline-parallel-aware neural network layers using a layer factory function and hidden layer count
merge_multimodal_embeddings: merge multimodal embeddings into input embeddings at placeholder token positions in a tensor
fast_topk: run an optimized top-k selection on a tensor using torch.max for k=1 and torch.topk for larger k values
